         2                      THE PRESIDENT:  The Senate will

         3       come to order.  Like to ask everyone to find

        18       Journal of Friday, January 15th, was read and

        19       approved.  On motion, Senate adjourned.

         8                      THE SECRETARY:  Legislative

         9       Resolution, by Senator Ohrenstein and others,

        10       commemorating the Chinese New Year, the Year of

        11       the Rooster, on Saturday, January 23rd, 1993.

        12                      THE PRESIDENT:  On the

        13       resolution, all those in favor say aye.

        14                      (Response of "Aye.")

        15                      Opposed nay.

        16                      (There was no response.)

        17                      The resolution is adopted.

         7       Resolution, by Senator Marchi, honoring the
